exposure: Establishment and activities of Outpatient Maternity Departments (OMD)
cohort: The study analyzed data from the Birth Registry concerning activities and impact on births occurring in the Krapina-Zagorje County, Croatia, primarily during the 1950s.
finding: The organization of Outpatient Maternity Departments (OMD) in Krapina-Zagorje County significantly improved perinatal care in the 1950s, with their subsequent closure coinciding with a continuing trend of perinatal and maternal mortality reduction due to the establishment of inpatient maternity hospitals.
mod_finding: Major obstetric procedures, including delivery by cesarean section, were not performed in the Outpatient Maternity Departments, necessitating transports for complicated labors.
